upload.name: EDGEfab
upload.description: EDGEfab {version}, the VS Code extension and its MCP server: not a game mod, so no Mod Manager Download. A preview: turns a textured 3D model, or your words, into a prop for the game. Needs REDcode. Extract, then in VS Code: Extensions view, ..., Install from VSIX. Or install it from the Marketplace or Open VSX, where it updates itself.
